afterAnswer.scope: Per activity within an active V6 learner session, as soon as first response is submitted; includes incorrect response and any later retry under maxUses.
afterAnswer.alreadyRevealed: Previously durably ACKNOWLEDGED hints remain read-only consultable as part of historical authorized view after the response, subject to session/revision isolation.
afterAnswer.pending: A pending AUTHORIZED but unacknowledged request is not an acquired hint; it must not newly reveal text after the first response. Require lifecycle-aware recovery/denial without silently discarding durable events. Exact pending-event transition design needs independent review.
afterAnswer.prohibited: No additional request IDs or authorization rank advances after response submission. Renderer must not present an active request control.

newSession.newStart: Each intentional fresh V6 course/activity session receives a different durable session UUID and a new empty per-session hint journal, even for the same installed kit and activity revision.
newSession.sameSessionResume: Reload of the same still-active session retains its UUID and acknowledged hint prefix.
newSession.priorHistory: Preserve existing historical journals unchanged and isolated by session, kit and revision. Do not carry prior-session hints into the new session, delete earlier journals, overwrite history or migrate V2–V5 data.
newSession.reviewRequired: Define historical browsing/retention/privacy and course restart-vs-activity restart mapping before actual learner write.

mastery.grade: Keep the established response grade/scoring outcome and answer maxUses unchanged.
mastery.independentEvidence: Separate pedagogical autonomy classification from numeric grade. For a correct response, autonomy=false if a hint was durably acknowledged in that session/activity before submission; if no hint has been acknowledged and the full journal is proven intact, autonomy classification may be considered independently. Missing/corrupt/unverified assistance state must not be recorded as autonomous success.
mastery.semanticBoundary: Do not silently change existing Atlas mastery/scoring event contracts or historical scores. Any new autonomy-event schema, derivation/counter update, and migration require independent domain acceptance before integration. No mastery metric increment as autonomous when evidence proves hint use.
mastery.tests: After one or more acknowledged hints, correct answer retains the same grade and maxUses, but is classified non-autonomous in any proposed V6 autonomy measure. Cross-session history is preserved without contaminating a fresh-session hint state.

Independent reviewer accepts semantics of assisted vs autonomous success without unapproved Atlas/scoring changes.
Native Chromium scenario covers request/ACK/view, submit, denied further request, read-only acquired hints, fresh session, persisted history and grade/maxUses invariants.
